findings.title: Published source did not compile / was not the deployed source — resolved by recovered deploy-time tree + byte-parity gate (W02)
Core deployed components unpublished — recovered and parity-proven (W02)
Factory owner can redirect any launch's creator fee recipient (3d notice + 3d window); reaches accrued-unswept fees and unreleased vest
Owner rescue hatches (rescueCurveFees, rescuePoolFees, rescueSweptGraduation, forceSweptGraduation)
Fee-sweep operator chooses conversion/buyback price floors
No external audit covers the current code (Class C01)
BUSL-1.1 code linked into the build (Class C04)

Compromised revenue attestor could exhaust the per-asset nonce space and sign an unbounded ceiling, permanently disabling the provenance bound — fixed: sequential nonces + ceiling <= escrow claimed + held

MEASURED on the real Robinhood 4663 RPC (PR CI): EVM block.number is the parent-chain number (26,193,299 vs RPC 88,673,151), so the splitter evidence-block check reverted StaleEvidence for every attestation — fixed: L2 head/hash read through ArbSys (0x64) when it answers, EVM opcodes elsewhere; real-chain confirmation is the A07c CI probe, not a local run

revokeRevenueAttestor() did not invalidate a pending attestor rotation: a matured proposal could be executed permissionlessly after the emergency revocation (reproduced) — fixed: revocation atomically discards the pending rotation and pauses pulls; claims unaffected

SignerRegistry trusted startup verification indefinitely (rotated/revoked on-chain authority kept signing; sticky disables never recovered) — fixed: fresh on-chain snapshot per signing request, fail closed on RPC failure

Robinhood fork lifecycle steps 7-9 (revenue attestation/pull/claims) are NOT VERIFIED on the Anvil fork (ArbOS emulation); reported as deferred item A07e and Class B B09 (production write acceptance not performed)
renounceOwnership is not disabled on ForgeBindingRegistry and ForgeLaunchAuthorizer; renouncing freezes authority rotation and the launch kill switch
Under a timelocked owner every owner function — including emergency stops — inherits the timelock delay; immediate containment relies on off-chain signer kill switches
rescuePoolFees never rescues a native-quote bucket (by design: native cannot fail to deliver); such fees can only leave via sweep
